newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: STM to represent MAN in Yugoslavia - paper.
newsitem.headline: STM to represent MAN in Yugoslavia - paper.

text.p: Truck manufacturer MAN has signed a deal with the Yugoslav STM company covering the import and service of its vehicles in Yugoslavia, the newspaper Vecernje Novosti said on Wednesday.
No-one at STM was immediately available for comment.
A service network will initially be opened in Belgrade, Novi Sad, Nis and Podgorica, STM business system owner Sveta Todorovic was quoted as saying.
MAN general manager Vicco Arnim said the deal has "laid the cornerstone for future wider cooperation that implies mutual investment and production".
Some 50 MAN vehicles were sold in Yugoslavia this year through the STM business system, each worth between 100,000 and 220,000 marks, the paper said.
